profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
A software engineer with a diverse experience across many disciplines (full stack, mobile, etc) and product domains (finance, customer service, gaming, medical) focused on connecting people to products

10+ years of experience in software architecture design and implementation. The past few years has been a little bit of shift for me, where I have been focusing on backend, Web Application development. I have a few years of Android Development under my belt, both on the application-side and hardware-side. I have also worked on image/video processing pipelines for various products.

* Full Stack, Web Application Development - Golang, Javascript, ReactJS
* Android Application - Java, Kotlin, REST APIs, Biometric Authentication, Firebase (Messaging, Persistence, Authentication)
* Android Hardware AOSP - NDK, C++, gRPC, JNI
* Video/Image Pipelines - Architecture, FFmpeg, Live Streaming Technologies (RTMP, HLS), OpenCV, vmaf, Kinect/Gesture recognition, GPU optimizations
* Prototype/Web/Game Development - python, javascript, elm, nodejs, lua 

I also love making origami! Hit me up for my signature dollar peacock :)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role: Full Stack SDE. Improving and maintaining the Shop/Marketplace for ID.me.

- Maintaining and improving the Shop/Marketplace UI
- Working with affiliate partners to integrate their connections
- Improving Admin features for internal associates to manage affiliate partners
- Improving CI/CD pipelines for faster build times

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role: Full Stack. Developing systems to process financial account data and integrating external partners into our finance marketplace platform

I worked on a few different teams (Lantern, Relay/Financial Insights, and Credit Score Monitoring).

On Relay/Financial Insights and Credit Score Monitoring:
- Developed various systems to update and aggregate members’ financial accounts helping to attract and retain members. (Kotlin)
- Built a system to automatically store and track real estate assets so our members can see an estimation of their networth. (Kotlin)
- Built up the infrastructure for a credit score monitoring system to track our members credit history and to inform our members of specific events (e.g. when their credit score increases or decreases).

On the Lantern team
- Integrated several external partners for marketplace platform expanding the loan offerings SoFi could provide for members. (Kotlin/node.js/Javascript)
- Integrated automatic lead analytic ingestion from external partners into an internal central data center (Snowflake) so our business leads can analyze and make key decisions. (Kotlin/Kafka).
positions.insights: Skills: RESTful WebServices · Python · Node.js · JavaScript · Kotlin · Team Mentoring · Gradle · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role: Full Stack. Developing customer service software for agents to communicate with customers.

- Developed + maintained various backend application services (run in docker containers, managed by Kubernetes, and deployed via AWS) to support the Agent-facing front-end
- Integrated a Voice Recording API
- Contributed towards a standard repository pattern
- Converted various MQTT endpoints to HTTP endpoints
- Designed + developed the Android Chat SDK (powered by WebView) to allow Android Developers to interface with Gladly Chat Services
positions.insights: Skills: RESTful WebServices · JavaScript · Go (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role: SDE. Improving, maintaining, and fixing game engine-related functionality and services in Android and C++

- Updated game engine build system to use CMake
- Updated the engine push notification system from GCM to FCM
- Integrated Biometric Authentication into Android and iOS
- Updated engine to support and use newest Android SDK features
positions.insights: Skills: Python · C++ · Firebase · Android SDK · Kotlin · Gradle · Lua

positions.title: Mentor
positions.description:
Role: Mentor to students in coding bootcamp.

I participated as a mentor in a Hackbright's built-in mentorship program for their aspiring students. As a mentor, I talked with my mentee weekly about her assignments, projects, interview tips, and general career questions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role: SDE. Design, implement, and support underlying software systems for low-latency Augmented Reality game platform.

- Design, implement, and support systems on main platform hub (Android)
- Supported and integrated API for game development (C++)
- Designed and implemented an underlying systems for processing/receiving usb data (C++)
- Integrated a system for image processing in a low latency environment (C++)
- Integrated visual debug utilities (libwebsockets, Javascript, and Elm)
positions.insights: Skills: Live Video Streaming · Python · NDK · Computer Vision · AOSP · C++ · gRPC · Android SDK · Gradle · Image Processing

positions.title: Software Development Engineer - Emerging Technologies
positions.description:
Role: SDE. Rapid prototyping and developing emerging computer vision technologies in potential consumer products (Amazon Echo Look, Amazon Echo Show).

- Implemented and integrated modules of image processing pipelines (C++, AfterEffects, FFmpeg)
- Prototyped UX designs using (Node.js, JavaScript)
- Integrated data synchronization with prototype products using AWS
- Collaborated across different teams to design and develop products
positions.insights: Skills: RESTful WebServices · Live Video Streaming · Python · MySQL · Node.js · Computer Vision · C++ · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL · Image Processing

positions.title: Principal Software Architect
positions.description:
Role: Architect. Designing, optimizing, and maintaining system architecture for medical device software. Also responsible for training new hires, resource planning/allocation, and software release cycles.

- Architected low-latency image processing pipeline for 3D engine (C++, OpenGL, CUDA)
- Developed custom UX toolkit for multi-monitor and 3D visualizations (C++, OpenGL)
- Optimized computer vision algorithms for limbus tracking (C++, OpenCv)
- Developed 3D video playback/editing engines (C++, FFmpeg, FLTK)
- Managed a team to develop iOS port of 3D video playback/editing engine
- Optimized CUDA ­based DICOM volume raycasting engine (CUDA)
- Integrated and administrated software build management (Bugzilla, JIRA, SVN, and GIT)
positions.insights: Skills: Live Video Streaming · OpenCV · Computer Vision · C · C++ · CUDA · Team Mentoring · OpenGL · ffmpeg · Image Processing

projects.title: TrueEdit
projects.description:
* Designed and maintained a 3D video editor specially made for ease-of-use for surgeons.
* Video Editor engine uses FFMPEG to demux/decode frames and to remux/encode in a correct and synced manner. Also used FLTK to create a custom easy to use, user-friendly UI.
* Responsible for new features, enhancements, and bug maintenance.

projects.title: TruePlan
projects.description:
* Designed and integrated a system for syncing patient data coming from a pre-operative device over a network to be used by a remote surgical machine using TrueWare.
* Designed and implemented  a server/client communication protocol to sync data with AWS (DynamoDB + S3)
* Dispatched and maintained EC2 cloud instances for communication management between different products
